anomalies.impact: The navigation computer cannot read any sensors, GPS, EEPROM, or talk to the flight-control computer; autonomous navigation and the flight-control loop are nonfunctional.

anomalies.observed: REG3's OUT and SENSE pins are on +3.3V, but the MCU rail +3V3 has no regulator connection. FCC2's VDD pins 11/27/50/75/100, VDDA pin 21 and VREF+ pin 20 are unconnected; NAVC2's VDD pins 19/32/48/64 and VSSA pin 12 are unconnected, and VSS pins 18/63 are tied only to each other, not to GND.

anomalies.observed: The FCC 25 MHz HSE crystal HSE3 pin 1 is on net NET0157 with FCC2 pin 5 (PE6), and HSE3 pin 3 goes through R28 to FCC2 pin 37 (PE7). FCC2's actual oscillator pins PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13) are not connected to the crystal; PH0 has only C91, and PH1 is tied to the VREF+_FCC filter, while the real VREF+ pin 20 is unconnected.
anomalies.expected: A 25 MHz HSE crystal must connect between PH0 and PH1 (FCC2 pins 12 and 13) with the specified load capacitors; PE6/PE7 are general-purpose I/O and cannot drive the HSE oscillator. The VREF+ filter should be on pin 20, not PH1.
